body.statement:
In the only regime not matched by \(\mathrm{prop:finite\text{-}history\text{-}envelopes}\), namely the factor-two logarithmic elbow between full-prefix plug-in control near \(4^T\leq n\) and collision-converse activation near \(4^k\geq100n^2\), use the proposed program \(\mathscr H_{\mathrm{tree}}\) to determine the optimal compatible-tree approximation and testing scale for \(G_{T,c}(P)\).  The approximation must give explicit polynomial degrees and coefficients, an explicit multinomial factorial or degenerate \(U\)-statistic retaining nested-count covariance, and dual priors supported on legal subtrees.  It must handle null prefixes and saturation and account for the first non-scalar two-prefix term
\[
(\delta-1)^2\frac{m_{h_1 1}(P)}{m_{h_1}(P)}
\frac{m_{h_2 1}(P)}{m_{h_2}(P)},
\]
whose descendant denominator is constrained by the ancestor parent-sum identity.  Determine whether the approximation, variance, and fixed-sample testing scales coincide throughout this elbow.

obligation.what_is_open: A common sharp scale for compatible-tree rational approximation, the second moment of its explicit multinomial factorial statistic, and fixed-sample dual priors supported on legal subtrees throughout the factor-two logarithmic elbow.
obligation.obstruction: Ancestor and descendant prefix masses recur in the same denominator product and obey parent-sum identities.  Independent scalar moment lifts miss the first mixed term, while a uniform polynomial error alone controls neither nested-count covariance nor the affinity of legal fixed-sample subtree mixtures.
obligation.attempted: Expanded the two-prefix product, proved the centered Hellinger modulus through boundary laws, built and optimized every truncated empirical prefix plug-in, and combined these upper bounds with every-depth complementary-context mixtures.
obligation.partial_result:
Proposition~\ref{prop:finite-history-envelopes} proves the all-domain truncated-prefix upper functions
\[
\min_{0\leq s\leq T}\min\{1,(\sqrt{v_s}+B_s)^2\},
\qquad
\min_{0\leq s\leq T}\min\{1,2\sqrt{20v_s}+2B_s\},
\]
and the every-depth lower functions
\[
\max_{1\leq k<T}\frac{b_{T-k}(\eta)^2}{8}(1-\rho_{n,k})_+,
\qquad
\max_{1\leq k<T}b_{T-k}(\eta)(0.90-\rho_{n,k})_+,
\]
in addition to the explicit parametric floors.  At two positive-mass prefixes, expansion of
\[
\prod_{t=1}^2\frac1{1+(\delta-1)m_{h_t1}(P)/m_{h_t}(P)}
\]
through second order shows that the first term not reducible to separate scalar approximations is
\[
(\delta-1)^2\frac{m_{h_1 1}(P)}{m_{h_1}(P)}
\frac{m_{h_2 1}(P)}{m_{h_2}(P)}.
\]
The descendant mass in the second ratio is constrained by the first prefix's parent-sum identity.  Null-prefix descendant leaf contributions vanish, so this algebra introduces no division at a null prefix.  These results isolate, but do not close, the factor-two logarithmic elbow.

body.justification: The finite-history envelopes remove every endpoint issue and isolate the exact compatible-tree approximation and testing problem still required.
body.gap: Explicit joint polynomial coefficients, their nested multinomial covariance bound, and fixed-sample legal-subtree priors are unavailable at a common sharp scale.
body.consumer: A solution would close the factor-two logarithmic elbow and feed the full frontier theorem.
